chunks: hidden animosity has become manifest and the pots of malice are boiling.

key_terms.مَرَاجِلُ الْأَضْغَانِ: pots of enmity / boiling vessels of hatred

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about hidden animosity when facing the enemy?
ai.summary: In this invocation from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) employs vivid imagery of 'boiling pots' (marajil) to describe the intensification of concealed hostility into open conflict, reflecting the political and military tensions of his era. This supplication highlights the transition from latent enmity to active confrontation, serving as a spiritual preparation for battle while acknowledging divine awareness of the opponents' true nature.

en.sayed-ali-raza: hidden animosity has become manifest and the pots of malice are boiling.
